fullTextEN: Hello, I am Xika from Taiwan!
How are you? Welcome to www.lazychinese.com!

fullTextZH: 今天我要告诉你一个故事，
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell you a story,

words.gloss: Covering One's Ears to Steal a Bell

fullTextEN: called 'Covering One's Ears to Steal a Bell'.

words.gloss: Covering One's Ears to Steal a Bell

fullTextEN: Covering One's Ears to Steal a Bell

fullTextZH: 有一天，小偷看到一口钟。
fullTextEN: One day, the thief saw a bell.
He liked this bell very much,
He wanted to steal this bell!
But this bell was very big,
Hmm, he thinks for a moment...

fullTextZH: 他可以放到袋子里拿走！
fullTextEN: He can put them in the bag and take them away!
Okay, now he starts to strike the clock!
The clock makes a very loud sound,

fullTextZH: 他怕大家听到钟的声音，
fullTextEN: He is afraid everyone will hear the clock's sound,
and know he is stealing the clock!
Now he can't hear the sound!
He continued to ring the bell—

fullTextZH: 你说现在有没有声音呢？
fullTextEN: Do you think there's sound now?

fullTextZH: 你觉得别人听到声音了吗？
fullTextEN: Do you think others heard the sound?
Only the thief himself can't hear.
He thinks others can't hear either!
Like this thief 'covering ears to steal a bell'

fullTextZH: “掩耳盗铃”就是有些人自己骗自己，
fullTextEN: 'Covering ears to steal a bell' means some people deceive themselves,

fullTextZH: 比如：一个人在学校考试拿了10分，
fullTextEN: For example: A person scores 10 points in a school exam,
but he changes it to 100 points himself,
this is covering one's ears while stealing a bell!
Second example: There is a person,

fullTextZH: 可是他一直对自己说啊：

fullTextEN: "I can't work because I'm not healthy,

fullTextZH: 可是大家都知道这个人他很懒惰，
fullTextEN: but everyone knows this person is very lazy,
so he doesn't have a job,
this person is also covering his ears while stealing a bell!

fullTextZH: 你的生活中有“掩耳盗铃”的人吗？
fullTextEN: Do you have people who 'cover their ears while stealing a bell' in your life?

fullTextZH: 他们做了什么掩耳盗铃的事呢？
fullTextEN: What kind of 'covering ears while stealing a bell' things have they done?
Please leave a comment and tell me!

fullTextZH: “掩耳盗铃”是一句中国的成语，
fullTextEN: 'Covering ears while stealing a bell' is a Chinese idiom,

fullTextZH: 成语都是很久以前的故事，
fullTextEN: Idioms are stories from long ago,

fullTextZH: 我们也常常在生活中看到一样的事！
fullTextEN: we often see the same things in life!
